description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rubber Seals for the Hardtop Shell.
Seals the Hardtop Shell where it sits down against the Bed Walls.
Comes with 2 Pieces (1 for each side)
52” Long x 1.25” Wide x 1/8” Thick
#22 & #23 on Diagram in Pictures
Has Self Adhesive Backing
Comes with Adhesive Pre-applied but additional adhesive may need to be applied on bottom of strip if the hardtop is to be taken on and off.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Rubber Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985- 1995 Hard Top
Suzuki SJ410 1980- 1984 Hard Top
